    • initialize

      public void initialize(GamePanelController gamePanelController, javafx.beans.binding.DoubleBinding tileSizeBinding)
      Initializes the controller's component's resize properties and animations. It sets the state variables to their default values.

      gamePanelController - is the controller of the gamePanel.
